message.content:
<teammate-message teammate_id="team-lead">
Repo: /home/phili/tools/cavecrew-mcp. Fix a chop bug, max 2 files: cave/skills.js + cave/zones.json.

BUG (ground-truth from live bot): chopTrees in cave/skills.js has a hard camp-quarantine — every tree candidate within 60 blocks of camp gets skipped, no exception (driver saw "camp quarantine" skips; /chop {"count":4,"maxDistance":48} from camp = chopped:0, mathematically can never succeed since maxDistance 48 < 60). But the tribe's own planted tree farm (grove_1, ~(8,91,68), 12.6 blocks from camp) is INSIDE the quarantine — the skill can never harvest our own grove. The quarantine exists to protect camp builds (log pillars etc.) from being chopped as "trees" — keep that protection, add a tight exception.

FIX:
1. cave/zones.json: add zone {"name":"grove_1","box":{"x1":4,"y1":85,"z1":63,"x2":13,"y2":105,"z2":74},"note":"planted tree farm — chop allowed here despite camp quarantine"}. Match existing entry format exactly.
2. cave/skills.js: find the camp-quarantine check in chopTrees (grep "quarantine"). Add exception: a candidate tree whose trunk-base coords fall inside a zone named grove_1 (or any zone whose name starts with "grove") from cave/zones.json is ALLOWED even inside the quarantine radius. Look for how zones.json is already loaded/used in this repo (dig-law zone code exists — grep zones.json / zone helpers in skills.js/runner.js) and reuse that loader/point-in-box helper rather than writing a new one. The exception must be tight: only inside the zone box, everything else in quarantine stays protected.

VERIFY: node --check cave/skills.js. Also check tests/ dir for any chop/zone-related test and run it if it exists and runs fast (npm test filtering ok, skip if the suite needs a live server).

Report: exact edit locations (file:line), how zones loader is reused, syntax/test results. Caveman style, exact refs.
</teammate-message>

src/cave/runner.js:1765-1792 — handleChat()/POST /chat: style validated to talk|status|fancy|rainbow (1774). talk->smartChat (auto-classify, 1784), status/fancy/rainbow->announce(style,...) directly (1786). No raw pass-through possible.
src/cave/skills.js:2541-2550, 2560-2568 — ensureTool() DEPOT lines: `if (typeof ctx.sayStatus==='function') await ctx.sayStatus(depotLine); else bot.chat(depotLine)`. Low severity, out-of-scope per chief note (eval aside).
grep across skills.js/runner.js confirms only these 2 bot.chat( sites outside runner.js's own smartChat/announce/mirrorOutboundChat.

cave/overseer.mjs:36 — `import { createRconChat } from './rconchat.js'`

cave/rconchat.js:167-174 — sayStatus() = `tellraw @a [...]` with msg body colored `gray` — this is real tellraw straight to every player's game chat.
cave/overseer.mjs:197 — `await grey(bot.name, bot.color, '(overseer) chop stopped — camp quarantine, trees only 60+ blocks out')` — narration, lands grey in game.
cave/overseer.mjs:217 — `await grey(bot.name, bot.color, '(overseer) hard-stuck — sent /trigger home (works only if sethome done)')` — status line, grey in game.
cave/overseer.mjs:223 — `await grey(bot.name, bot.color, '(overseer) stuck — relogged; /trigger home next if still frozen')` — status, grey in game.
cave/overseer.mjs:242 — `await grey(bot.name, bot.color, `(overseer) ${ch.say}`)` — chore narration (e.g. "chore: farm round"), fires every chore tick, grey in game.
cave/overseer.mjs:271 — `await grey(bot.name, bot.color, `(overseer) ${d.say}`)` — idle-default narration (e.g. "idle: chop wood", "idle: tidy camp"), fires on every idle-timeout across whole fleet, grey in game.

Severity ranking:
1. cave/overseer.mjs:132/197/217/223/242/271 — HIGH. Live, always-on background process, fires routinely (every idle timeout + every chore, fleet-wide), pure status/narration text, straight tellraw grey to @. This is exactly banned class chief named. Commit 706c9b0 fixed runner.js path only — overseer.mjs never touched, still runs old raw-rcon narration.
2. cave/skills.js:2549,2567 — LOW. Only reachable off bare/test ctx, not real runner flow; chief flagged eval-adjacent paths as separately-warned territory.

Routing table:
- game WHITE (real chat, bot.chat verbatim): "!"-prefixed (runner.js:209-217), PROTOCOL_PREFIX ledger lines (runner.js:218-224), explicit /chat style=talk that matches either (1784), skills.js bare-ctx DEPOT fallback (2549/2567, leak).
- game GREY (tellraw, deliberate real-chat moments): announce style fancy/rainbow only (runner.js:154-155,176-183); rconchat.js sayFancy/sayRainbow.
- Discord feed only: announce('status',...) when discord.webhookUrl configured (runner.js:143-146) via discord.mjs postStatus.
- log only (no discord, no game): announce('status',...) fallback (runner.js:148, 169).
- game GREY, LEAK (bypasses all of above): overseer.mjs grey() -> rconchat.js sayStatus -> tellraw @, for every "(overseer)..." line.

VERDICT: LEAK — runner.js's own status routing (announce/smartChat) is clean and matches commit 706c9b0's claim, but cave/overseer.mjs still calls rconchat.js's sayStatus directly (overseer.mjs:132, fired at:197,217,223,242,271), putting "(overseer)..." status/narration straight into grey game chat, fleet-wide, on every idle default and chore tick — chief's "not even grey" rule broken there. Secondary minor leak: skills.js:2549/2567 bare-ctx DEPOT fallback, real white, only off test/eval-built ctx.
---
Ramp done. Sent full report to team-lead.

Short version:
- Steps 1-4, 8 = PASS (status, sethome, goto camp, re-sethome, narration).
- Step 5 = FAIL: chest (11,89,55) is gone, ground-truth confirmed, not stale read.
- Step 6 = PARTIAL PASS: /chop hit new bug — 60-block camp quarantine that blocks even tribe's own grown grove. Worked around via manual /eval dig, got 4x oak_log.
- Step 7 = SKIPPED: no chest to deposit into.

Logged 2 new FEEDBACK.md entries (chest missing, chop quarantine bug). Also flagged to team-lead: idle-guard was firing despite brief saying it's off, server had mid-ramp restart (handled clean via /relog), and unrecognized chat name ("KloputzKarl") seen — not addressed to us. No FEL/human contact needed reply.

Final bot state: pos (9.5,91,69.5), hp20/food20, connected, holding 4 oak_log + junk. Verdict sent: ready to scale to bot #2, but chest should get fix/rebuild decision first."}}
